_comment: This is ONLY a reference template showing the shape of the file.
You do NOT need to upload it anywhere or edit it by hand:
the server generates it at /.well-known/assetlinks.json (see server.js).
All you need to do is set the SHA-256 fingerprint in the server’s
ANDROID_FINGERPRINT environment variable. Google Play Console provides it
Play Console -> App integrity -> Play app signing
